comment: The Dark Project (upstream dead 2024-04): I.AI.getActivePackage() returns nil for actors with no active AI package; both helpers deref it unguarded, crashing twice per frame per NPC (~98k errors/session, visibly interrupting NPC movement). Guard added; find anchors on the enclosing function name so each patch applies exactly once.
replace:
is_following = function()
        local pkg = I.AI.getActivePackage()
        if not pkg then return false end -- MRI fixup: upstream nil-deref

in_combat = function(with)
        local pkg = I.AI.getActivePackage()
        if not pkg then return false end -- MRI fixup: upstream nil-deref
